policy: Evidence must be current-run and case-scoped.
Helper status is never PASS or FAIL by itself.
Screenshots support structured evidence but do not replace concrete DOM/network/result values.
Tool Bridge response is required only when irreversible/native dialog execution is actually reached.

metricRows.after.purpose: Row state after action; must prove requested metrics were selected.

fieldPicker.signature.purpose: Detect stale field picker options after source report changes.

fieldPicker.state.purpose: Row-scoped field picker open/search/select evidence for frontend observation cases.

browserMcp.preflight.purpose: Prove whether browser MCP was actually attempted before a case records TOOL_EXECUTION_UNAVAILABLE.

topbar.userButton.state.purpose: Frontend observation evidence for logged-in user button text and visibility.

projectToolbar.buttons.state.purpose: Frontend observation evidence for icon-only toolbar enabled/disabled states.

reportMode.radio.state.purpose: Frontend observation evidence for default report mode selection.

dateRange.panel.state.purpose: Frontend observation evidence for date panel composition without preview execution.

dateRange.presetSwitch.state.purpose: Frontend observation evidence for clicking multiple dynamic date presets and reading the resulting date button labels.

validation.message.state.purpose: Frontend observation evidence for invalid-operation validation messages.

sidebar.companySharedGroup.state.purpose: Frontend observation evidence for company shared sidebar expand/collapse behavior.

projectLimit.toast.state.purpose: Frontend observation evidence for project-limit blocking notification.

projectList.rowActionTooltip.state.purpose: Frontend observation evidence for row-local action icon tooltip lifecycle.

sourceReportPicker.state.purpose: Frontend observation evidence for source-report picker open/search/select behavior.

dateRange.timeTypeTab.state.purpose: Frontend observation evidence for dynamic/static time type tab selection.

dateRange.cancelFlow.state.purpose: Frontend observation evidence for date-panel cancel behavior.

editorToolbar.download.state.purpose: Frontend/integration evidence for editor toolbar download trigger.

download.toast.state.purpose: Frontend observation evidence for download-started toast.

saveModal.cancelFlow.state.purpose: Frontend observation evidence for opening save modal, typing a temporary name, cancelling, and verifying no report row is created.

saveModal.saveFlow.state.purpose: Current-run evidence for saving or overwriting a report and verifying list/read-back state.

copyModal.cancelFlow.state.purpose: Frontend observation evidence for copy modal default values and cancel behavior.

copyModal.saveFlow.state.purpose: Current-run evidence for copying an existing report, saving it under a new name, and verifying the new row.

projectList.reportRow.state.purpose: Report-list row visibility evidence after save/copy/cancel flows.

reportListEvidence.purpose: Helper-level report list readiness and row visibility evidence.

editorToolbar.update.state.purpose: Current-run evidence for clicking the existing-report update-settings button.

reportPersistence.reopenState.purpose: Read-back state after updating an existing report and reopening it from the project list.

reopen-report-evidence.purpose: Artifact-level evidence emitted when reopening a saved report from the project list.

toolBridge.response.purpose: Authorization evidence for irreversible/native dialog execution only.

blockedCategories.FIELD_PICKER_STALE_AFTER_SOURCE_CHANGE: Field picker options did not refresh after changing the source report.
blockedCategories.FIELD_PICKER_SOURCE_MISMATCH: Field picker options appear to belong to a different source report than the row source.
blockedCategories.EXECUTE_PRECONDITION_NO_SELECTED_FIELDS: Preview execute was blocked because no metric field was selected.
blockedCategories.EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT: Required current-run evidence was not collected.
blockedCategories.TOOL_EXECUTION_UNAVAILABLE_WITHOUT_PREFL: A case claimed browser tool execution was unavailable without browserMcp.preflight evidence.
blockedCategories.OBSERVATION_SEMANTIC_MAP_MISSING: The DOM state was readable, but the domain pack lacked a semantic map to interpret it.
blockedCategories.BLOCKED_NEEDS_VISUAL_REVIEW: Structured observation evidence was insufficient and current-run screenshot review is required.
